reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (North Carolina, focus year 2021)

    Question: Does NC eviction law explicitly regulate landlords with minimal rental properties
    (e.g., <=5 single family homes; <=3 homes/properties; <=3 condo/co-op units)?

    Statutes provided:
      [1] NC Gen Stat  42-40 (2021) Definitions
      [2] NC Gen Stat  42-14 (2021) Notice to quit in certain tenancies

    This program encodes those statutes and the question scenario, then derives yes/no.
*/

% --------------------------
% Scenario (facts)
% --------------------------

scenario_state(north_carolina).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The question's "minimal landlord" categories (encoded as the scenario's target categories).
scenario_minimal_landlord_category(five_or_fewer_single_family_homes, max_count(5)).
scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_less_homes_or_rental_properties, max_count(3)).
scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_less_condo_or_coop_units, max_count(3)).

% Helper that succeeds when the question scenario is fully represented in facts.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(north_carolina),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_minimal_landlord_category(five_or_fewer_single_family_homes, max_count(5)),
    scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_less_homes_or_rental_properties, max_count(3)),
    scenario_minimal_landlord_category(three_or_less_condo_or_coop_units, max_count(3)).

% --------------------------
% Statutes (translated)
% --------------------------

/* [1] NC Gen Stat  42-40 (2021) - Definitions (Article scope definitions)
   Encoded as deterministic definitional facts.
*/
statute_ncgs_42_40_definition(2021, action,
    includes([recoupment, counterclaim, defense, setoff, other_proceeding_including_action_for_possession])).

statute_ncgs_42_40_definition(2021, premises,
    means(dwelling_unit_including([mobile_home, mobile_home_space]),
          includes([structure_part, facilities, appurtenances, grounds, areas, facilities_held_out_for_residential_tenants_use]))).

statute_ncgs_42_40_definition(2021, landlord,
    means(any_owner_or_authorized_agent,
          includes([owner, rental_management_company, rental_agency, other_person_with_actual_or_apparent_agent_authority]))).

statute_ncgs_42_40_definition(2021, protected_tenant,
    means(tenant_or_household_member_victim_of([domestic_violence_chapter_50b, sexual_assault_chapter_14, stalking_chapter_14]))).


/* [2] NC Gen Stat  42-14 (2021) - Notice to quit in certain tenancies
   Encoded as minimum notice requirements in days.
   Note: For "one month or more" we encode the minimum as 30 days.
*/
statute_ncgs_42_14_min_notice_days(2021, year_to_year, 30).
statute_ncgs_42_14_min_notice_days(2021, month_to_month, 7).
statute_ncgs_42_14_min_notice_days(2021, week_to_week, 2).
statute_ncgs_42_14_min_notice_days(2021, manufactured_home_space_any_term, 60).

/* Core concept for this question:
   "Explicitly regulate landlords with minimal rental properties" means: the statute text
   includes rules/definitions that turn on the NUMBER of units/homes/properties owned.

   The provided NC statutes (42-40 and 42-14) do NOT create any such property-count-based
   classification. We encode that by providing no successful instances of property-count thresholds.
*/

% If NC eviction law (as provided here) had an explicit "small landlord" threshold, it would appear here.
% Intentionally fails for all inputs, because the provided statutes contain no such thresholds.
statute_property_count_threshold(_State, _Year, _Category, _MaxCount) :-
    fail.

% Derived legal conclusion: explicit regulation exists only if a property-count threshold exists.
statute_explicitly_regulates_minimal_landlords(State, Year) :-
    statute_property_count_threshold(State, Year, _Category, _MaxCount),
    !.

% --------------------------
% Reasoning to answer the question
% --------------------------

% The question is answered "yes" only if:
%   (a) the scenario is about minimal-property landlords, AND
%   (b) the encoded statute set explicitly regulates landlords based on property count.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    statute_explicitly_regulates_minimal_landlords(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% --------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% --------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate landlords with minimal rental properties? This includes includes: landlords who own five or fewer single family homes; landlords who own three or less homes or rental properties; and owners of three or less condominium or cooperative units.
